rubrics.date: Rubricae generales 80: April 25; when that day is Easter Sunday or Easter Monday, the following Tuesday.
rubrics.scope: Rubricae generales 81: observed in the Mass only, not in the Office, and not a commemoration de Tempore.
rubrics.rank: Rubricae generales 108–109 f: a privileged commemoration, made in all Masses.
rubrics.admission: Rubricae generales 111 a–c and 434 a–c: one privileged commemoration is admitted on first-class days, on second-class Sundays in place of the second-class feast, and on other second-class days.
rubrics.conclusion: Rubricae generales 436–437: each commemoration oration follows the corresponding Mass oration under its own, separate conclusion; 480–481: only the last Secret's terminal is audible.
